candidates.title: Kia PV5 Chassis Long Range gets 71.2 kWh battery as sole UK option
candidates.lead: Kia plans to sell PV5 Chassis exclusively with its 71.2 kWh Long Range battery in the UK. The South Korean firm says the additional capacity is intended for operators with longer or less predictable routes and fewer charging opportunities. According to the firm, the 71.2 kWh battery is paired with a 120 kW electric motor and supports DC charging up to 150 kW. Kia says charging from 10 to 80 per cent takes around 30 minutes, while a full 10-100 per cent charging takes around six and a half hours with an 11 kW AC supply. The same battery is already available in the PV5 Cargo and Passenger models in the UK. However, the Chassis version will be offered with the larger battery as its only choice.
